name: course-video-packager
description: Turn a full lecture recording into a publishing package: chapters planned from the transcript and long pauses, one video per chapter, subtitles cut and re-timed per chapter (SRT + VTT), a cover image for every chapter and the course, an outline (Markdown, JSON, CSV, chapter list for video descriptions) and a zip. Uses the ffmpeg on your computer; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a full lecture recording into a publishing package: chapters planned from the transcript and long pauses, one video per chapter, subtitles cut and re-timed per chapter (SRT + VTT), a cover image for every chapter and the course, an outline (Markdown, JSON, CSV, chapter list for video descriptions) and a zip. Uses the ffmpeg on your computer; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把整段课程录像整理成发布包：根据字幕内容和较长停顿规划章节，每章导出一段视频，字幕按章切分并重新对齐时间（SRT + VTT），每章和整门课都生成封面，附课程目录（Markdown、JSON、CSV、可贴到视频简介的章节时间）并打成 zip。使用电脑上已安装的 ffmpeg，无需 API 密钥。

ffmpegPath.title: ffmpeg 路径（可选）
ffmpegPath.description: 可选。ffmpeg 可执行文件的完整路径。默认在 PATH 和 /opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin 中查找。

fontPath.title: 中文字体文件（可选）
fontPath.description: 可选。封面文字使用的字体文件（.ttf/.otf/.ttc）。默认自动查找系统中文字体。
